title: JAY — buyJay() ERC721 Callback Reentrancy Attack Analysis
root_cause: The `buyJay()` function is vulnerable to reentrancy via the ERC721 `transferFrom` callback during NFT transfer; by calling `sell()` upon reentry before state is updated, the attacker can sell at a price higher than the original purchase price
steps: → Sells JAY at inflated price → receives ETH
